remit: strongest defensive, slowdown, stress or risk-off macro expression
stance_summary: The cleanest slowdown expression is still receive-duration in AONIA 2027 H1: IB is pricing a full extra tightening cycle into an already-open Australian housing channel, which is a policy-error tail rather than a sustainable hike path.

trade.structure: Receive / long duration in ASX 30-day AONIA (IB). Existing paper book is locked to the 2027-03/04/05/06 strip average under alias AONIA_2027-06; profits when the canonical implied-rate mark falls.

expression_comparison.rates_candidate: Long duration / receive AONIA_2027-06 (locked IB 2027-03/06 strip): fade the remaining ~59bp of extra tightening versus overnight AONIA 4.35.
expression_comparison.spot_candidate: Short AUDUSD: housing/labor stress plus global tightening as AUD-negative versus a still-hawkish USD.
expression_comparison.rationale: The discrepancy is RBA path versus an already-open housing transmission, which lives in AONIA implied rates. AU 2Y is at the 99th one-year and five-year percentiles while AUDUSD is only the 76th one-year / 84th five-year percentile and mixes a separate Fed-hike USD bid. Rates own the policy-error directly; spot is a noisier risk-off overlay.

context_build.causal_mechanism: FACT: NSW stamp-duty receipts fell 24% y/y in August, transaction volumes fell 18%, and Sydney/Melbourne home values are down more than 7% from peak, while AU labor already shows employment -15.8k m/m and unemployment 4.5%. INFERENCE: the RBA cash-rate channel is biting the most rate-sensitive private-demand block first. If that transmission continues, the Board cannot deliver the full extra tightening still in IB without amplifying a housing/income feedback loop, so 2027 H1 AONIA implied rates should fall. UNKNOWN: whether inflation score 82 and the energy overlay still force at least one more delivered hike before that feedback is acknowledged.
context_build.path_to_current_price: FACT: overnight AONIA is 4.35 as of 17-Sep-2026. The IB strip then re-prices a hiking path: 4.565 in 2026-10 (+21.5bp), 4.685 in 2026-11 (+33.5bp), 4.86 in 2027-03 (+51bp), 4.94 in 2027-06 (+59bp), flattening near 4.945 by 2027-07/08. AU sovereign 2Y is 4.999 as of 2026-09-16, +39.1bp over one month, 99.0th percentile over both 1y and 5y; 10Y is 5.348, also 99th percentile. AU 2s10s is only +34.9bp and has flattened 13bp over one month. Paper mark on the locked 2027-03/06 strip remains 4.9075, matching the current four-contract average. INFERENCE: the last month’s yield surge is the market capitalizing a late-cycle RBA tightening impulse after the Fed hike and energy/global-rates overlay, not a housing-recovery signal. UNKNOWN: how much of the 2Y jump is term-premium versus genuine hike-odds, because the packet does not decompose those components.
context_build.known_vs_new_information: KNOWN: Fed delivered 25bp to 3.75–4.00%, August US CPI kept a tightening bias, BoJ hiked to 1.25%, and desk thesis says the energy shock is constraining global easing. KNOWN: AU inflation gauge is 82 on July CPI 3.5% y/y and trimmed mean 3.6%. NEW in this packet relative to a stale hike narrative: September Westpac-MI sentiment fell 5.2% to 84.4 with a broad-based decline, housing-slump evidence dated 16-Sep remains the live tightening-channel print, and IB still has ~59bp extra tightening in 2027-06 after that housing print. INFERENCE: the path is still being set by global hawkish headlines, while the domestic leading channel has already turned. UNKNOWN: post-17-Sep RBA communication is not in the packet.
context_build.market_implied_assumption: FACT: IB prices roughly two additional 25bp-class tightenings from 4.35 into a 4.94 2027-06 implied rate, with most of that by 2027-03. That path requires the RBA to keep tightening, or to keep a higher terminal, despite the housing print. INFERENCE: the market is treating AU inflation 82 and global energy/Fed/BoJ tightening as dominant over housing/labor deterioration, i.e. a 2022-style hike-through-pain reaction function.
context_build.market_assumption_disagreed_with: The priced assumption that is wrong is that the RBA can still deliver, or hold, ~50–60bp of extra tightening into 2027 H1. INFERENCE: housing volumes, stamp duty and falling home values are the binding constraint; extra hikes from here are a policy error that gets reversed in the 2027 window rather than locked in as a new terminal.
context_build.price_decomposition: FACT: level versus change on the policy curve is overnight 4.35 versus 2027-06 4.94 (+59bp). Front IB 2026-10 already has +21.5bp and liquid OI 21752; back 2027-06 has null OI/volume. Sovereign AU 2Y 4.999 sits ~65bp above overnight AONIA and ~6bp above 2027-06 IB. One-month sovereign change is the aggressive leg (+39.1bp 2Y, +37.1bp 5Y, +26.1bp 10Y) while the 1d change is a small give-back (-5.5bp 2Y). INFERENCE: the marginal driver of the current price is a re-steepening of the hike path after global tightening news, not a housing-data fade. The 2027 H1 window is where the full extra cycle is stored; that is the tenor that owns the disagreement.

historical_reference.distribution: FACT: AU 2Y/5Y/10Y are all at the 99th percentile over both 1y and 5y as of 2026-09-16. AU 2s10s is only the 24th percentile 1y. That is a high-rate, relatively flat-curve distribution, not a recession-steepener yet. AONIA IB is an upward-sloping hike strip from 4.35 to ~4.94, not an easing strip.
analogs: 2022-23 RBA hiking cycle into falling Australian house prices: inflation dominance kept the Board hiking after housing had already turned; the analog warns that inflation 82 can delay the duration payoff.
Late-2008 / early-COVID rate-sensitive housing transmission: once volumes and prices broke, policy was forced off the tightening path even with residual inflation tails.
historical_reference.regime_differences: FACT: current AU headline CPI 3.5% y/y and trimmed mean 3.6% are not 2022 peak-CPI; labor is loosening (U 4.5%, employment -15.8k) rather than overheating. COUNTER: energy-market shock absorbers are weakening, BoJ is at a 31-year high, and the Fed has just hiked, so imported inflation and global term-rate pressure are more 2022-like than 2008/2020. UNKNOWN: no packet analog with matched oil-shock plus housing-volume collapse plus 82 inflation score, so both analogs are partial.

independent_checks: Housing channel (mw_20260916_au_housing_tightening / housing rollup): stamp duty -24% y/y, transactions -18%, dwelling values >7% below peak — a physical/fiscal print of tighter financial conditions.

Labor and surveys (temp:AU:labor, temp:AU:consumer, temp:AU:activity): employment -15.8k, unemployment 4.5%, WPI 3.2% vs 3.4% a year earlier, September sentiment 84.4 down 5.2%, RBA August business conditions modestly weaker — corroborating demand cooling independent of house prices.

Cross-market (rates:AU vs fx:AUDUSD): AU 2Y at 99th percentile while AUDUSD is only 76th 1y / 84th 5y and already -0.73% over 5d — rates have priced far more hawkishness than FX has priced housing stress.
context_build.flow_and_positioning_check: FACT: CFTC positioning is partial/null (pos:cftc as_of null). AONIA 2027-06 OI and volume are null; 2027-03 OI is only 201 with volume 1; the liquid IB is 2026-10 (OI 21752, volume 4450). INFERENCE: the back of the strip is not a documented crowded long; thin OI is a liquidity risk, not evidence of one-way ownership. UNKNOWN: dealer, CTA, or real-money holdings of IB/ACGB are not in the packet, so flow cannot be used as the explanation for the 1m yield surge.

policy_path_check.pricing_summary: AU: AONIA overnight 4.35 (17-Sep-2026); IB 2026-10 4.565 (+21.5bp), 2026-11 4.685 (+33.5bp), 2027-03 4.86 (+51bp), 2027-06 4.94 (+59bp). US: SOFR overnight 3.85 after the 25bp hike to 3.75–4.00%; SR3 2027-03 4.58, 2027-09 4.755 peak. CA: CORRA overnight 2.29; CRA 2027-03 3.13 (+84bp), 2027-06 3.365 (+107.5bp). NZ policy path and NZ sovereign yields are unavailable in this packet.
policy_path_check.rationale: Short-end AU duration cannot be read from the 2Y percentile alone. The live IB strip shows ~59bp of extra tightening still stored in 2027-06 after the housing print; that is the priced policy path being faded. US and CA paths are independent checks that global hikes are priced, not substitutes for AONIA.

trade.thesis: FACT: Australian housing is already contracting under higher rates, labor is loosening, and September consumer sentiment reversed lower, while IB still prices AONIA 4.94 in 2027-06 versus overnight 4.35. INFERENCE: that remaining hike cycle is a policy-error / slowdown tail. Receiving the locked AONIA 2027 H1 strip is the defensive expression: it pays if housing transmission forces the RBA off the extra ~50–60bp, without needing a global crash. UNKNOWN: whether one more delivered hike still prints before the Board reacts.
trade.mispricing: IB 2027-06 implied 4.94 is +59bp versus overnight AONIA 4.35, and AU 2Y 4.999 sits at the 99th 1y/5y percentile, after NSW housing volumes and stamp duty have already collapsed. The market is pricing hike-through-housing; the bear disagreement is that the extra tightening will not be locked in as the 2027 H1 terminal.
why_now: Housing-slump evidence (16-Sep) is contemporaneous with an unchanged ~59bp IB hike path into 2027-06, so the discrepancy is live rather than already faded.
September Westpac-MI sentiment drop to 84.4 is a new demand-side confirmation after July spending had still been firm.
Existing book already owns this exact expression at strip mid 4.9075; the packet does not show housing repair or a delivered extra 50bp, so the edge has not been invalidated.

last24:BoJ raises its policy rate to 1.25%
trade.horizon: 1–4 months, through the next RBA decision cluster into the 2027 H1 IB window
trade.entry: Packet/book canonical mark 4.9075 on AONIA_2027-06 (paper_books; equal to the 2027-03/04/05/06 IB implied-rate average of 4.86/4.895/4.935/4.94). Single 2027-06 contract implied 4.94. Overnight AONIA 4.35 as of 17-Sep-2026.
trade.invalidation: RBA delivers or IB fully prices the remaining ~50–60bp of tightening while housing volumes/prices and labor stop deteriorating, or AU inflation remains in the score-82 regime with no further demand break.
catalysts: Further housing-volume, clearance, or stamp-duty deterioration versus an unchanged IB hike path.
Labor softening beyond July’s employment -15.8k / unemployment 4.5% that forces RBA communication off extra tightening.
A follow-through in Westpac-MI or business conditions that confirms the September sentiment break.
principal_risks: AU inflation score 82 (headline 3.5%, trimmed mean 3.6%) can still justify delivered hikes regardless of housing.
Energy-shock overlay and Fed/BoJ tightening can keep imported inflation and global term yields bid, lifting IB with US/JP rather than with housing.
July household spending +1.1% m/m shows the consumer channel is not uniformly broken; a rebound in sentiment would delay the thesis.
2027-06 IB is illiquid (null OI/volume); the locked strip can gap on sparse prints.
Official SOFR 3.85% ACT/360 vig continues on shocked risk capital even if the mark is unchanged.

conflict_synopsis.core_view: IB still prices ~59bp of extra RBA tightening into an already-open housing downturn; receive 2027 H1 AONIA as the policy-error/slowdown expression.
conflict_synopsis.key_catalyst: Housing/labor/sentiment deterioration that forces the RBA off the remaining IB hike path.
conflict_synopsis.key_invalidation: RBA delivers or IB prices the remaining 50-60bp while housing and labor stop deteriorating.
